ScheduleMeeting.description: Organizes a new calendar event or meeting.

entities.participants: List of people or email addresses to invite
entities.time: The specific time of the meeting
entities.date: The specific date of the meeting
entities.duration: How long the meeting will last (e.g., 30 mins, 1 hour)

SendEmail.description: Drafts or sends an electronic mail to a contact.

entities.recipient: The name or email of the person receiving the mail
entities.subject: A brief summary of the email's purpose
entities.body_summary: The main point or message content to be included

DeviceControl.description: Adjusts hardware or IoT devices in the user's environment.

entities.device: The specific piece of hardware (e.g., Lights, AC, Fan, PC)
entities.action_type: The state change requested (e.g., Turn On, Turn Off, Set Temperature, Dim)
entities.value: The numerical setting if applicable (e.g., 22 degrees, 50% brightness)
entities.room: The location of the device (e.g., Bedroom, Kitchen, Office)

SearchDocumentation.description: Looks up technical info or company policies in the knowledge base.

entities.query: The specific topic or keyword to search for
entities.source: Optional specific documentation set (e.g., HR Portal, GitHub, Wiki)

Attendance.description: Records or checks the attendance of a person.

entities.person_name: The name of the individual whose attendance is being recorded or checked
entities.date: The date for which the attendance is relevant
entities.status: The attendance status (e.g., Present, Absent, Half-day, Leave)
entities.reason: The reason provided for an absence or leave, if any
